written: 2026-11-20, after SeedLM-21, before any retrieval distance was computed
question: Is a held-out program near a training program that a search by its description finds?
motivation: SeedLM-12 (grafts) and SeedLM-21 (generated Python-node programs): data with new compositions made the teacher's programs more probable without the coder writing more of them correctly; more compositions raise the wrong neighbours as well
MBPP-style tasks come in families; a relative found by the description could make the right composition salient instead of making every composition likelier
measure: scripts/seedlm22_retrieval.py: for each held-out teacher program (and the 77 with a new combination) and each held-out development one-liner (15), the smallest token edit distance to a training program among the top 1, 5 and 20 ranked by content words shared with the description (ties: same number of arguments), and to any training program; how often a top-k program has the same shape (leaves reduced to kinds). Training programs: training parts of the teacher tasks, variants, composed tasks, development one-liners, and the engine's programs on training development tasks
baseline: the coder's own first verified program at beam width 32 (s5-var; reports/seedlm/nearmiss_s5-var.json): within 2 tokens for 68 of 139 held-out teacher programs and 4 of 15 beyond
decision: A coder that reads a retrieved program is built (as SeedLM-23) only if a top-5 program is within 2 tokens of the held-out program for at least 24 (30%) of the 77 held-out teacher programs with a new combination, or for at least 5 of the 15 beyond programs; otherwise retrieval by description is set aside

outcome.result: a top-5 program within 2 tokens: 15 of the 77 held-out teacher programs with a new combination (19%; top 20: 26) and 3 of the 15 beyond programs (top 20: 3). Below both bars (24 and 5): retrieval by description is set aside (reports/seedlm/retrieval_distance.json)
outcome.reported: the nearest training program of all is within 2 tokens for 36 of the 77 and 8 of the 15 (all 139 held-out teacher programs: 85; top 5: 49): near relatives exist for about half of the programs the coder misses, but the description's words do not lead to them; a top-5 program has the same shape for 1 of the 77 and none of the 15
